Scans the screen list sys+0x98..+0xa0; if a screen with id hash 0x77c8bd01 (at [+0xa0]) already shows a widget whose [+0x50] hash equals the panel hash, it only refreshes: for each screen whose first widget has +0x690>0 it calls 0x14384fd50, sets +0x690=5 and restarts the QPC timestamps +0x678/+0x680.
